## Summary

This PR implements three major components for the FinAegis core banking platform:

### 1. CQRS Infrastructure (Command Query Responsibility Segregation)
- **Command Bus**: Handles write operations with async support via Laravel queues
- **Query Bus**: Manages read operations with built-in caching capabilities  
- **Domain Event Bus**: Priority-based event handling with transaction support
- **Full test coverage** for all infrastructure components

### 2. Liquidity Pool Impermanent Loss (IL) Protection
- **Tiered Coverage System**:
  - 7-30 days: 20% coverage
  - 30-90 days: 40% coverage
  - 90-180 days: 60% coverage  
  - 180+ days: 80% coverage
- **Protection Features**:
  - Minimum 2% IL threshold for claims
  - Automatic fund requirement calculations
  - Event sourcing integration for audit trail
- **5 New API Endpoints**:
  - `GET /api/liquidity/il-protection/{positionId}` - Calculate IL for position
  - `POST /api/liquidity/il-protection/enable` - Enable IL protection for pool
  - `POST /api/liquidity/il-protection/process-claims` - Process pending claims
  - `GET /api/liquidity/il-protection/fund-requirements/{poolId}` - Get fund requirements
  - `GET /api/liquidity/analytics/{poolId}` - Get pool analytics

### 3. Documentation & Quality Improvements
- Comprehensive architecture documentation
- OpenAPI/Swagger annotations for all new endpoints
- Code quality verified with PHPStan (Level 5)
- Code formatting applied with PHP CS Fixer
- Updated TODO.md to reflect completed work

## Technical Details

### Files Changed
- **Infrastructure**: 5 new files implementing CQRS pattern
- **Liquidity Pool**: 2 new events, 1 service, controller updates
- **Tests**: Comprehensive unit tests for IL protection
- **Documentation**: Architecture diagrams and API docs

### Testing
All tests passing:
- ✅ PHPStan Level 5 analysis
- ✅ PHP CS Fixer formatting
